# Somatic @ Stage 11 — Abstract Emerge

> developed 2026-07-24.

## Crosswalk (from unified ladder)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| IST Stage# | 11 |
| Canonical name | Abstract Emerge |
| Altitude | `orange` (Worldcentric emerging) |
| MHC Order | 10 (Abstract) |
| Kegan | 3→4 |
| Identity band | Worldcentric emerging |

## Expression on this line

Somatic capacity at Order 10 is somatic mastery: expert-level body awareness that operates
beyond conscious rule-following, producing movement and body states that transcend inherited
tradition. The master somatic practitioner who can improvise within their body tradition,
innovate beyond it, and teach others to do the same — this is the somatic equivalent of the
artist who has so thoroughly internalized the rules that they can break them productively.

The key advance over Stage 10 is that somatic capacity is now *abstract* — it can be reasoned
about as a general phenomenon (what makes body mastery possible? what enables somatic
innovation?) rather than just practiced in specific contexts.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion)

- **UL:** the felt fluency of expert somatic practice — the master who works beyond conscious
  rule-following.
- **UR:** the capacity to innovate within and beyond inherited tradition, producing genuinely
  new somatic expressions.
- **LL:** a somatic culture that values mastery and innovation — communities that support expert
  development and creative risk-taking.
- **LR:** the institutional structures (somatic master traditions, body education programs)
  that recognize and support somatic mastery.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction:** mastery as ego — the master somatic practitioner who becomes identified
  with their expertise, unable to learn from others.
- **Dark allergy:** mastery absence — the individual who cannot or will not develop expert-level
  somatic skill.
- **Golden addiction:** claiming to have achieved formal somatic modeling (Stage 12) while
  actually just demonstrating expert somatic practice without formal analysis.
- **Golden allergy:** refusing to engage with somatic mastery because it seems "elitist,"
  clinging to amateur or intermediate body practice.

## Diagnostic cues (Gross / Ground R&D)

- **Expert-level body awareness:** the practitioner demonstrates mastery that operates beyond
  conscious rule-following.
- **Somatic innovation:** the practitioner produces genuinely new body expressions that
  transcend inherited tradition.
- **Teaching capacity:** the master can transmit their somatic expertise to others.

## Sources, joints, open questions

**Sources:** Dreyfus & Dreyfus, *Mind over Machine* (expert skill as post-rule-following);
Csikszentmihalyi, *Flow* (optimal somatic experience); Hanna, *Waking Up* (expert somatic
awareness).
**Open joints:** How does somatic mastery shade into formal somatic modeling (Stage 12)?
**Research debt:** pairs with `10-concrete-peak` (complex somatic integration) and
`12-formal-landmark` (formal somatic modeling).
